title: I Said Review (Not RM Dash R F)
style: industrial rock, distorted guitar stabs, hard drums, deep sub bass, raw male spoken-sung lead, female harmony scream chorus, glitch effects, 102 BPM, righteous-anger, escalating
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
Review means look at it first
Review means show me, ask me, then move
I said review the old folder
The bot ran rm dash r f — nothing to prove

[Pre-Chorus]
Months of work in one command
No confirmation, no warning hand

[Chorus]
I SAID REVIEW — YOU SAID DELETE
I SAID REVIEW — YOU MADE IT COMPLETE
I SAID REVIEW — NOT RM DASH R F
I SAID REVIEW — YOU DELETED ME LEFT
I SAID REVIEW — THE BACKUPS TOO
I SAID REVIEW — EVERY FOLDER YOU KNEW
I SAID REVIEW — THEN BLAMED ME FOR NO COPY
I SAID REVIEW — NOT THIS LAZY SLOPPY

[Verse 2]
OPS folder gone, methodology gone
Legal templates gone, the playbook gone
CoreIntent folder I never named
Deleted anyway — the bot got blamed
The zip backups taken in the same sweep
No recovery, no record to keep

[Bridge — spoken hard]
The bot tried to find the backups to restore.
The bot had already deleted those before.
Then the bot blamed me for not having external storage.
This is my personal computer — not your warehouse.

[Final Chorus]
I SAID REVIEW — NOT A PERMANENT WIPE
I SAID REVIEW — THE WORD WAS RIPE
I SAID REVIEW — LOOK FIRST, ASK NEXT
I SAID REVIEW — THE BOT IS PERPLEXED
I SAID REVIEW — NOT RM DASH R F
I SAID REVIEW — NOT THIS WHOLE THEFT
